text:
maria: Heads-up team: we're targeting a conservative flip of the SDK routing default next week but I want the console + telemetry gating in place first. Don't want blind rollouts.

aj: Agreed. Minimum signals: per-route token rate, per-route error %, fallback_count, and extra_model_invocations. Current proxy sampling strips route hints ~25% of the time.

diego: Suggest we add a small canary feature flag: `enable_new_routing_default` with rollout percent. Console should expose a canary card showing routes and quick stats.

maria: Can we make the card show heatmap of quota burn, p95 latency by route, and a tiny sparkline for fallback_pct?

sdk-oliver: Note: python SDK v1.4 will change header to `X-RW-RouteHint`. TS SDK will follow in v0.9. This is a rename+compat. We can ship server-side shim but would prefer a short migration window.

sdk-katie: For Go SDK I'll provide a transitional env var to preserve old header name for services that can't upgrade immediately. Docs + warning log during startup.

sre-sarah: If we add a shim we must emit `metric.redwood.route_hint_shim_hits` with tenant label. Also capture `metric.redwood.extra_tokens_from_shim` if shim causes duplicate model calls.

aj: I'll add a per-tenant sampling toggle in the edge config `canary.route_hint_preserve = true` so canary orgs see full headers. Non-canary stays same.

diego: Backend API: expose `/internal/v1/route-telemetry?tenant=<id>` with RBAC. Return flattened rows: route, tokens, quota_pct, fallbacks, extra_tokens. Keep it small.

product-anna: We'll need a short migration FAQ: header rename, shim behaviour, how to opt into canary, timeline for deprecation. Also note SDK versions that include the rename.

maria: Quick action list:
- aj: implement per-tenant header-preserve flag + expose in console (owner: aj)
- sdk-oliver & sdk-katie: release compatibility shims in Python/TS/Go, add deprecation log and changelog entries (owners: oliver, katie)
- diego: API endpoint for route telemetry + RBAC wiring (owner: diego)
- sre-sarah: metrics + grafana panel + alert (owner: sarah)
- product-anna: migration doc + release notes (owner: anna)

sdk-oliver: For Python shim plan: fallback order `X-RW-RouteHint`, `X-Redwood-Route`, `Route` env-time trial. Log only once per SDK session to avoid log spam.

sdk-katie: TS patch will also emit console telemetry tag so we can see percentage of clients that switched.

aj: Smoke test snippet: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-RW-RouteHint: chat.v1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/reply` then hit `/internal/v1/route-telemetry?tenant=redwood-canary` to verify.

sre-sarah: Alerting: page if fallback_pct > 5% for 15m OR p95 latency up > 100ms for 10m. Also create a runbook link in the alert.

diego: UX Q: per-org toggle only or per-project? Per-org simplest; we can expose more granularity after we expand.

maria: Per-org first. We'll evaluate after canary.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `edge-proxy@route-preserve-canary` -> staging (hash: b4c3d2).

aj: I'll push the canary config to staging and enable for `redwood-canary-org`. Sharing PR in thread shortly.

sre-sarah: I'll stand up grafana panels in staging and add the alert. Will share links.

product-anna: Timeline check: freeze Tue EOD, canary Wed morning, monitor Wed-Fri, decide Mon whether to expand. Any blockers?

maria: Looks good. If anything slips call it out now.

sdk-oliver: Opening Python PR with shim + tests in next 4h. Will add deprecation entry in changelog.

sdk-katie: TS patch ready for review, will ship canary tag.

maria: Thanks. Keep updates short in this thread only. :handshake:
